arxiv-2012-05650.title: Dephasing-assisted entanglement in a system of strongly coupled qubits
arxiv-2012-05650.creator: I. V. Vovcenko, V. Yu. Shishkov, E. S. Andrianov
arxiv-2012-05650.description: Abstract abstract Creation of entangled states of quantum systems with low decoherence rates is a cornerstone in practical implementation of quantum computations. Processes of separate dephasing in each qubit in experimentally feasible systems is commonly accepted to destroy entanglement. In this work, we consider a system of two strongly coupled qubits that interact with dephasing reservoirs.

arxiv-2203-05171.title: Multi-Band Superconductivity in Strongly Hybridized 1T’-WTe 2 /NbSe 2 Heterostructures Preprint: APS/123-QED
arxiv-2203-05171.creator: Wei Tao, Zheng Jue Tong, Anirban Das, Duc-Quan Ho, Yudai Sato, Masahiro Haze, Junxiang Jia, K. E. Johnson Goh, BaoKai Wang, Hsin Lin, Arun Bansil, Shantanu Mukherjee, Yukio Hasegawa, Bent Weber

Johnson Goh, BaoKai Wang, Hsin Lin, Arun Bansil, Shantanu Mukherjee, Yukio Hasegawa, Bent Weber. The interplay of topology and superconductivity has become a subject of intense research in condensed matter physics for the pursuit of topologically non-trivial forms of superconducting pairing.

arxiv-2203-12184.title: A Theoretically Grounded Benchmark for Semantic Evaluation of Machine Common Sense
arxiv-2203-12184.creator: Henrique Santos, Ke Shen, Alice M. Mulvehill, Yasaman Razeghi, Deborah L. McGuinness, Mayank Kejriwal
arxiv-2203-12184.description: Abstract Achieving machine commonsense has been a longstanding problem within Artificial Intelligence. Thus far, benchmarks that are grounded in a theory of commonsense, and can be used to conduct rigorous, semantic evaluations of commonsense reasoning (CSR) systems have been lacking. We propose the first such benchmark, called Theoretically-Grounded Commonsense Reasoning (TG-CSR) .

arxiv-2212-14351.title: Properties of Group Fairness Metrics for Rankings
arxiv-2212-14351.creator: Tobias Schumacher, Marlene Lutz, Sandipan Sikdar, Markus Strohmaier
arxiv-2212-14351.description: Abstract In recent years, several metrics have been developed for evaluating group fairness of rankings. Given that these metrics were developed with different application contexts and ranking algorithms in mind, it is not straightforward which metric to choose for a given scenario.

arxiv-2302-07573.title: Learning Hierarchical Resource Allocation and Multi-agent Coordination of 5G mobile IAB Nodes
arxiv-2302-07573.creator: Mohamed Sana, Benoit Miscopein
arxiv-2302-07573.description: Abstract We consider a dynamic millimeter-wave network with integrated access and backhaul, where mobile relay nodes move to auto-reconfigure the wireless backhaul. Specifically, we focus on in-band relaying networks, which conduct access and backhaul links on the same frequency band with severe constraints on co-channel interference.

arxiv-2310-13942.title: Approximate Implication for Probabilistic Graphical Models
arxiv-2310-13942.creator: Batya Kenig
arxiv-2310-13942.description: Abstract The graphical structure of Probabilistic Graphical Models (PGMs) represents the conditional independence (CI) relations that hold in the modeled distribution. Every separator in the graph represents a conditional independence relation in the distribution, making them the vehicle through which new conditional independencies are inferred and verified.

arxiv-2311-14959.title: Nonequilibrium hyperuniform states in active turbulence
arxiv-2311-14959.creator: R. Backofen, Abdelrahman Y. A. Altawil, Marco Salvalaglio, A. Voigt
arxiv-2311-14959.description: Abstract We demonstrate that the complex spatiotemporal structure in active fluids can feature characteristics of hyperuniformity. Using a hydrodynamic model, we show that the transition from hyperuniformity to non-hyperuniformity and anti-hyperuniformity depends on the strength of active forcing and can be related to features of active turbulence without and with scaling characteristics of inertial turbulence.

arxiv-2402-04409.title: Towards Fair, Robust and Efficient Client Contribution Evaluation in Federated Learning
arxiv-2402-04409.creator: Meiying Zhang, Huan Zhao, Sheldon Ebron, Kan Yang
arxiv-2402-04409.description: Abstract The performance of clients in Federated Learning (FL) can vary due to various reasons. Assessing the contributions of each client is crucial for client selection and compensation. It is challenging because clients often have non-independent and identically distributed (non-iid) data, leading to potentially noisy or divergent updates.

arxiv-2404-05000.title: Portable diamond maser with reduced magnetic field through orientation
arxiv-2404-05000.creator: Wern Ng, Yongqiang Wen, Neil Alford, Daan M. Arroo
arxiv-2404-05000.description: Abstract Masers have the potential to transform medical sensing and boost qubit readout detection due to their superb low-noise amplification. The negatively-charged nitrogen vacancy (NV - ) diamond maser is the only continuous-wave solid-state maser discovered at room temperature, however it suffers from requiring large and bulky magnets which prevent its more widespread use.

pmc-10480443.title: Large-scale assembly of isotropic nanofiber aerogels based on columnar-equiaxed crystal transition
pmc-10480443.creator: Lei Li, Yiqian Zhou, Yang Gao, Xuning Feng, Fangshu Zhang, Weiwei Li, Bin Zhu, Ze Tian, Peixun Fan, Minlin Zhong, Huichang Niu, Shanyu Zhao, Xiaoding Wei, Jia Zhu, Hui Wu
pmc-10480443.description: Ice-templating technology holds great potential to construct industrial porous materials from nanometers to the macroscopic scale for tailoring thermal, electronic, or acoustic transport. Herein, we describe a general ice-templating technology through freezing the material on a rotating cryogenic drum surface, crushing it, and then re-casting the nanofiber slurry.

pmc-10832060.title: Advancing ecological validity and clinical utility in virtual reality-based continuous performance test: exploring the effects of task difficulty and environmental distractors
pmc-10832060.creator: Hyang-Kyeong Oh, Yoon Jae Cho, Jae-Jin Kim, Bokyoung Shin, Soo-Jeong Kim, Soobin Park, Jeong-Ho Seok, Soyeon Kim, Eunjoo Kim
pmc-10832060.description: IntroductionResearchers have highlighted concerns regarding the limited diagnostic utility and ecological validity of the Continuous Performance Test (CPT). Recent advancements in VR-based CPTs have attempted to address these concerns by simulating real-life scenarios and enhancing attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) diagnosis; however, certain areas require improvement for obtaining reliable data from both healthy individuals and those with ADHD.

pmc-11485038.title: Identification of potential novel targets for treating inflammatory bowel disease using Mendelian randomization analysis
pmc-11485038.creator: Ji-Chang Fan, Yuan Lu, Jin-Heng Gan, Hao Lu
pmc-11485038.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundInflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is a complex autoimmune disorder, although some medications are available for its treatment. However, the long-term efficacy of these drugs remains unsatisfactory. Therefore, there is a need to develop novel drug targets for IBD treatment.MethodsWe conducted two-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) analysis using Genome-Wide Association Study (GWAS) data to assess the causal relationships between plasma proteins and IBD and its subtypes.

pmc-11596415.title: Impact of Condensed Tannin and Sulfur Dioxide Addition on Acetaldehyde Accumulation and Anthocyanin Profile of Vitis vinifera L. Cv. Cabernet Sauvignon Wines During Alcoholic Fermentation
pmc-11596415.creator: Qinglong Wang, Xiaoqian Cui, Jiaqi Wang, Heqiang Chang, Junzhe Wang, Ang Zhang, Yang Zhou, Zhiyong Xu, Lingmin Dai, Guomin Han
pmc-11596415.description: Acetaldehyde is a key carbonyl by-product during red wine alcoholic fermentation; it is reactive and takes part in certain reactions involving anthocyanin. The aim of this study was to investigate the influence of SO2 and condensed tannin on the acetaldehyde accumulation of Saccharomyces cerevisiae (S. cerevisiae) during alcoholic fermentation and the ripple effect on wine anthocyanin.

pmc-11829094.title: Nonparametric regression estimator of multivariable Fourier Series for categorical data
pmc-11829094.creator: Muhammad Zulfadhli, I Nyoman Budiantara, Vita Ratnasari
pmc-11829094.description: In recent years, Fourier Series estimators in nonparametric regression for quantitative data have received significant attention. However, in reality, there is often a relationship between response and predictor, where the response is categorical data. Some methods developed today to address the case of qualitative response data use only certain approaches. No Fourier Series estimator can handle categorical response data.

pmc-12581229.title: Childhood vaccine hesitancy among academics in Türkiye
pmc-12581229.creator: Aylin Palloş, Cevriye Yüksel Kaçan
pmc-12581229.description: BackgroundVaccine hesitancy has been increasing both in Türkiye and worldwide, posing a growing challenge to public health efforts.AimThis study aimed to determine the level of childhood vaccine hesitancy among academics in Türkiye.MethodsThis descriptive and cross-sectional study was conducted between June 15 and December 15, 2021.

pmc-12595754.title: EVATRAN (The Effect of Eplerenone on the Evolution of Vasculopathy in Renal Transplant Patients): study protocol for a cross-over randomized controlled trial
pmc-12595754.creator: Arnaud Simon, Nicolas Girerd, Frédéric Jaisser, Erwan Bozec, Xavier Lepage, Ludovic Mercklé, Patrick Rossignol, Luc Frimat, Sophie Girerd
pmc-12595754.description: BackgroundArterial stiffness is a major prognostic factor of cardiovascular (CV) morbi-mortality in kidney transplant (KT) patients. Preclinical studies have demonstrated that the vascular toxicity of calcineurin inhibitors (CNI) is mediated through the activation of the mineralocorticoid receptor (MR) in vascular smooth muscle cells. Additionally, the role of MR in contributing to arterial stiffness is well documented in non-transplanted individuals.

pmc-13132402.title: Impaired glycosylation promotes rapid transition to hepatocellular carcinoma in model of diet-induced steatotic liver disease
pmc-13132402.creator: Abhishek K Singh, Balkrishna Chaube, Kathryn M Citrin, Joseph WM Fowler, Sungwoon Lee, Jonatas Catarino, James Knight, Sarah C Lowery, Sonal Shree, Keira E Mahoney, Nabil E Boutagy, Inmaculada Ruz-Maldonado, Kathy Harry, Marya Shanabrough, Trenton T Ross, Stacy A Malaker, Yajaira Suárez, Carlos Fern
pmc-13132402.description: Obesity-linked steatosis is a significant risk factor for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC); however, the molecular mechanisms underlying the transition from metabolic dysfunction–associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) to HCC remain unclear. Here, we explored the role of the ER-associated protein NgBR, an essential component of the cis-prenyltransferase (cis-PTase) enzyme, in chronic liver disease.

pmc-13222635.title: Development of a Prediction Model for Severe Pediatric Mycoplasma pneumoniae Pneumonia: A Single-Center Retrospective Study
pmc-13222635.creator: Zeyu Zeng, Guang Li, Yanbing Xu, Na Dong, Danying Zhu, Rong Yin, Haiqin Zhong, Lang Yuan, Libing Shen, Guohui Ding, Xiaoyan Dong
pmc-13222635.description: BackgroundMycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia (MPP) is a common pediatric respiratory infection, with 10–40% of cases progressing to severe MPP (SMPP). Macrolide-resistant Mycoplasma pneumoniae (MRMP) harboring the A2063/2064G mutation is closely associated with disease severity and treatment failure, posing a major clinical challenge.

pmc-13356064.title: Beyond the algorithm: rethinking the network account of trustworthy ai through lexical threshold-based multidimensional utility analysis
pmc-13356064.creator: Fei Song, Julian Savulescu, Michael Dunn
pmc-13356064.description: In this paper, we present an overview of the main conceptual framework for trustworthy AI and argue that the network account offers a superior alternative. We identify and illustrate the possible nodes within an AI network, specify the key attributes each node should possess, and clarify what constitutes a sufficient threshold for each attribute.
